results.title: Remote and Hybrid Work Policy
results.heading: Core hours
results.text: All employees must be available between 10:00 and 15:00 in their local time zone on working days.

results.title: Leave Policy
results.heading: Part-time employees
results.text: Part-time employees earn paid leave in proportion to their contracted hours. An employee contracted for 20 hours a week earns 10 days per year.

results.title: IT Security Policy
results.heading: Lost or stolen devices
results.text: A lost or stolen device must be reported to the IT service desk within 24 hours.

results.title: Remote and Hybrid Work Policy
results.heading: Security while remote
results.text: When working outside the office, employees must follow the IT Security Policy, including the VPN rule for public Wi-Fi.

results.title: Leave Policy
results.heading: Requesting leave
results.text: Requests for 3 or more days of leave must be submitted in the HR portal at least 10 working days in advance.
